summary: The candidate adds a valid regression for the ROCm-scoped broadcast already present at the recorded base; it is test-only hardening, not the implementation fix. Its exact tests pass and fail when the HIP broadcast block is temporarily removed. However, the original greedy TP-consistency contract is broader than HIP, and an independent non-HIP greedy near-tie case still returns divergent accepted-draft counts with no broadcast. The candidate's result.json therefore overstates the outcome as fixed.

tests.what_was_measured: The candidate regression also passes unchanged on the exact recorded base: 3 passed. This confirms the implementation fix predates the candidate. Raw output: base-regression.log.
At exact candidate commit cad9443d635cf595832da6a7e4d6f82ce81adcf4, all three candidate tests passed on GPU. Raw output: candidate-regression.log.

tests.command: same candidate pytest after temporarily removing only the existing _is_hip broadcast block
tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before mechanism check: the synchronization and DP-attention routing tests failed while TP=1 passed (2 failed, 1 passed). The source was restored byte-for-byte afterward. Raw output: mutated-failing-before.log.

Independent adversarial case: with _is_hip false, world_size=2, and opposite near-tied GPU logits, the greedy branch issued zero broadcasts and returned different accepted-draft counts (3 versus 2). Raw output: nonhip-counterexample.log.

tests.command: repository-source import and ROCm environment probe with the prepared interpreter
tests.what_was_measured: Imported eagle_utils from /job/repo/python on Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2; one AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950 GPU was visible. Raw output: import-environment.log.

gpu_execution.evidence: Candidate and adversarial tests allocated the near-tied logits and decision tensors on the assigned AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950 GPU. Only one GPU was visible.

remaining_counterexamples: For a non-HIP greedy path with TP world_size 2 and per-rank near-tied logits, eagle_sample performs no finalized-decision broadcast and logical ranks retain different accepted-draft counts (3 versus 2).
A real two-rank ROCm collective/deadlock reproduction remains unverified because only one GPU was assigned; the candidate uses a replay mock rather than an actual process group.
remaining_limitations: Only one AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950 GPU was available, so no real TP=2 or multi-node collective was run.
No production EAGLE/GLM weights were available; full serving, semantic accuracy, and --enable-aiter-allreduce-fusion were not exercised.
The candidate changes only tests and reports. The existing source fix is HIP-scoped and predates both the candidate and recorded base.
No native source changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
